blocking.issue: An operator following RA-1 literally cannot publish a Revision. RA-1 is file mode with OCI pull and no Ruralz Control, but its CI step ends in a bare `ruralz bundle push`. The CLI reference makes `--env` required for push. Without `--oci REFERENCE`, push uploads the source Bundle to Ruralz Control, which RA-1 does not have. Push also does not list `--environments`, so `--env` would fetch the Environment from Ruralz Control. As written, the command fails (no `--env`) or targets the wrong system (no `--oci`). This regression was raised as L2-7 in the previous round and is still present. It also breaks the audience criterion: the reference architecture is the operator's recipe.
blocking.evidence: Doc RA-1: "CI runs `ruralz bundle validate` and `ruralz bundle build --env prod`, both with `--environments control/environments.yaml`, then `ruralz bundle push`". CLI and API surface command table: "`ruralz bundle push` | Send source to Ruralz Control, or a signed Revision to OCI | `[DIR]`, `--env` (required), `--oci REFERENCE`, `--key PATH` (else Sigstore keyless)"; line 191: "Without `--oci`, `ruralz bundle push` uploads the source Bundle with the CLI's digest; Ruralz Control re-renders it"; line 163: "`--environments FILE` | Local `Environment` resources; without it, `--env` fetches from Ruralz Control (Planned (M2))".
blocking.fix: Change the RA-1 cell to: 'then `ruralz bundle push --env prod --oci <registry>/<repository>`, signing with Sigstore'. In the same cell, or as a new Open question (for example OQ-deployment-topologies-20, owner cli-and-api-surface, Blocking: Yes, for Planned (M2) OCI pull), state that push needs `--environments` to render without Ruralz Control. Apply the same flags wherever T1 and T2 or Figure 2 imply a file-mode push. The body is at about 4,499 of 4,500 words, so offset the few added words by trimming text that resolved no finding. The Scope sentence '[T4] decides five questions...' and Figure 1's second caption clause are candidates.

non_blocking.section: Topology catalog (T4 chart object table, RBAC row)
non_blocking.suggestion: The `ruralz-control` grants cover only 'cluster-scoped CRD status updates'. The Configuration model gives every namespaced CRD object a 'Status subresource with conditions', so Ruralz Control also needs `update` or `patch` on `<kind>/status` in each bound namespace. Migration tooling rewrites stored objects before a version is dropped, Planned (M3), which needs `update` on the objects themselves plus `patch` on `customresourcedefinitions/status`. List those three grants explicitly so the chart's Roles are complete.
